content:
pagerbot: paging maria-sre: auth spike (high error rate) on edge-proxy-1 — 1200 401s/min, possible token leakage. Pager severity: P1.
maria-sre: I've pulled the alert, looking at the logs now.
jules-eng: FYI I see a sudden burst of POST /auth/token with user-agent 'curl/7.68' from 3 IPs. Sending sample lines.
jules-eng: ```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z edge-proxy-1 auth request id=5f2a user_id=svc-legacy token=eyJ... ip=203.0.113.42
2026-03-17T09:12:04Z edge-proxy-1 auth request id=5f2b user_id=svc-legacy token=eyJ... ip=198.51.100.23
```
maria-sre: Those token prefixes look like long-lived svc account tokens. Could be a leaked debug log.
devin-sec: tagging in. @maria-sre stop all downstream logshipper sinks to external buckets and set SOC egress WAF rule to block the three IPs (203.0.113.42, 198.51.100.23, 192.0.2.11).
maria-sre: Started blocking IPs on edge WAF and paused logshipper job log-forwarder-prod via `kubectl scale deployment/log-forwarder-prod --replicas=0 -n telemetry`
ops-lead: Heads-up to infra: isolate svc-legacy credentials. Rotate immediately and revoke any active tokens.
jules-eng: Which key? svc-legacy has two tokens in KMS labeled 'svc-legacy-prod' and 'svc-legacy-maint'.
devin-sec: Start with rotating 'svc-legacy-prod' first. Sam, can you coordinate customer-impact comms? @sam-pm
sam-pm: On it. Drafting a short status for customers: "We detected anomalous auth activity affecting token validity for a small set of service accounts; we are rotating credentials and there may be transient auth failures. No user data confirmed leaked." Will continue.
maria-sre: Running token revocation script now: `python tools/revoke_tokens.py --service svc-legacy --since 2026-03-17T08:00Z`
maria-sre: Token revocation returned ~14k sessions revoked. Rolling restart of services that cache tokens starting.
jules-eng: Quick note: I found a splunk job that exported raw auth debug logs to a staging S3 path with public ACL set in March. Copy of artifacts exists at s3://redwood-staging-archive/auth-debug/2026-03-16-*. Need retention check.
devin-sec: Legal loop-in: @legal — potential PII in debug logs? We need legal review for notification thresholds.
legal: Reviewing. Please snapshot the log files and isolate them. Avoid further copies.
customer-success: Notifying top-10 impacted customers in private thread. We'll route updates to the status page if user-facing.
ops-lead: Can we confirm if the leaked S3 path was public-read or internal?
jules-eng: ACL shows public-read for a short window (2026-03-16T23:40 to 2026-03-17T01:10). Objects were enumerated during that time by unknown agent.
maria-sre: Blocking public access on the bucket and initiating object-level delete of debug artifacts: `aws s3 rm s3://redwood-staging-archive/auth-debug/ --recursive --profile infra-cleanup`
devin-sec: We're doing key rotation: KMS key alias/rotate-svc-legacy -> new key material created. Plan: rotate service account tokens, invalidate cached tokens via cache-invalidator job, and add temporary tighter token TTL (1h) for all svc accounts.
jules-eng: Pushing a quick config change: auth-service.config -> token_ttl_seconds=3600; deploying canary to 2 instances.
maria-sre: Canary looks healthy. No new 401 surge in canary region.
devin-sec: Next steps: 1) complete rotation and reissue tokens 2) confirm no other buckets exposed 3) run artifact search for token strings in last 90 days 4) prepare customer notice if PII found.
sam-pm: Draft customer notice v1 ready for review. Adding note: "We rotated affected credentials and implemented extra monitoring; available mitigations: rotate service account keys and invalidate cached sessions."
legal: Requesting timeline and list of affected customers. Avoid use of 'leak' in external language until confirmation.
maria-sre: Handoff to on-call (maria --> night-sre) at 09:30UTC. Creating ticket INC-20260317-3141.
devin-sec: I'll stand by for deeper forensics; assigning @jules-eng and @maria-sre to artifact analysis. If evidence of exfil > 100 distinct objects or any PII, we'll escalate to incident commander and notify customers per policy.
ops-lead: Coordinating billing/usage alerts for any anomalous egress charges.
customer-success: Confirmed outreach to customers scheduled at 10:00UTC unless forensic changes wording.
maria-sre: Quick checklist for handoff to night-sre: commands run, blocked IPs, bucket ACL changed, token rotation performed, objects removed, incident ticket link: INC-20260317-3141.
pagerbot: Incident paging cleared for maria-sre (acknowledged) — continued monitoring enabled.
maria-sre: All good for now; leaving monitoring watchers and a follow-up postmortem assigned. Will add timeline and OSS of commands to the ticket.
